text: 富国银行在10月16日的前瞻中预计，美国9月住房开工将环比再降2.0%，年化总量降至125万套。数据将于下周二公布。该行指出，随着按揭利率持续上升，住房开工在过去五个月中已有四个月下降。9月底，按揭利率突破7%，购房负担进一步加重。美国全国住宅建筑商协会的调查显示，建商对未来销售的预期明显恶化，降价情况增多。多户住宅建设也受到融资成本上升、租金涨幅有限的拖累。建筑许可回落，则是该行预计9月开工继续下降的另一依据。
text_en: Wells Fargo in its October 16 outlook forecast that US September housing starts will fall another 2.0% month on month to an annualized total of 1.25 million units. The data will be released next Tuesday. The bank noted that with mortgage rates continuing to rise, housing starts have fallen in four of the past five months. At the end of September, mortgage rates broke through 7%, further increasing the burden of home purchases. A survey by the National Association of Home Builders showed that builders' expectations for future sales have deteriorated markedly and price cuts have increased. Multifamily housing construction is also being weighed down by rising financing costs and limited rent growth. The decline in building permits is another basis for the bank's forecast that September starts will continue to fall.
